name: Device Status
creator: NanoKVM Community
desc: NanoKVM system health, network status and QR codes for the web UI, Wi-Fi and custom links.

WIFI_PASSWORD.label: Wi-Fi password
WIFI_PASSWORD.description: Optional. When set, adds a QR code that joins phones to the Wi-Fi network.

WIFI_SSID.label: Wi-Fi network name
WIFI_SSID.description: Network for the Wi-Fi QR code. Leave empty to use the network the NanoKVM is on.

WEB_UI_URL.label: Web UI URL
WEB_UI_URL.description: Optional override for the Web UI QR code, for example a DNS name. Defaults to https:// plus the current IP.

QR_LINKS.label: Extra QR links
QR_LINKS.description: Comma-separated links shown as extra QR pages, optionally labelled: Dashy=http://raspberrypi.local:4000, https://example.com
